// A deliberate type error. tests/typecheck-gate.test.ts copies this into src/components/ as an
// .astro file and asserts `astro check` fails on it, because `astro build` and `tsc --noEmit` both
// exit 0 against exactly this input. Without that asymmetry proven, the package's typecheck task
// could be swapped for `tsc` and nothing would notice.
interface Props { readonly count: number }
const { count } = Astro.props
const wrong: string = count
---
<span>{wrong}</span>
